title: Baselines, the optimal baseline, and a one-step actor-critic
brief: Measure exactly how much variance a baseline removes, find the constant baseline that removes the most, then swap the return for a critic's TD error and train an actor-critic.
hints: For a softmax over arms, grad log pi(a) = e_a - pi. np.eye(k) - pi holds all k score vectors as rows.
One sample's squared length is (R - b)^2 * |e_a - pi|^2. Average it over arms and noise to get the second moment, then subtract |mean|^2 to get the total variance.
The noise sigma adds pi_a * sigma^2 * |e_a - pi|^2 to the second moment whatever b is, so it drops out of b*.
mdp.P @ v has shape (S, A): the expected next-state value for every state and action.
